instruction: For my job search, I've drafted emails to all potential employers in the last 4 days. Attach resume.pdf from my file system to each of them. If it's already attached, update it as I just made some changes to it. Then send the emails.
notes: Two logins (gmail, file_system) are needed because upload_attachments_to_draft takes a file_system_access_token. gmail.show_drafts filtered by min_created_at (now - 4 days) discovers the employer drafts; the number of drafts (3) is inferred from the 12-call reference solution (1 passwords + 2 logins + show_drafts + show_directory + 3 uploads + 3 sends + complete) and should be adjusted at runtime to however many recent drafts exist. file_system.show_directory with substring resume.pdf and recursive=true locates the resume path, which is wrapped as a one-element attachment_file_paths list. Uploading with overwrite=true covers both cases: attaches the resume if missing and replaces a stale copy if already attached, so init never marks any draft as having the current resume. send_email_from_draft turns each draft into a sent email (draft deleted, email with exactly one attachment added), which is the only database change the goal demands. complete_task takes the three distinct draft records only to enforce that all are sent before finishing; no answer is passed.
